text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After claiming victory in the Satsuki<n>Sho, Symboli
Rudolf raises one finger<n>high. The message is
clear: one<n>crown down, two to go. Up next is the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Air Groove and the<n>general
manager visit the waiting<n>room, where Symboli
Rudolf waxes<n>lyrical about her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Moved, the general manager decides<n>to remain in
the student council, but<n>Air Groove seems
displeased with<n>Rudolf's handling of the situation.
